text: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation{H3248} is in the holy{H6944} mountains.{H2042}
Jehovah{H3068} loveth{H157} the gates{H8179} of Zion{H6726} More than all the dwellings{H4908} of Jacob.{H3290}
Glorious things{H3513} are spoken{H1696} of thee, O city{H5892} of God.{H430} {H5542}
I will make mention{H2142} of Rahab{H7294} and Babylon{H894} as among them that know{H3045} me: Behold, Philistia,{H6429} and Tyre,{H6865} with Ethiopia:{H3568} This one was born{H3205} there.
Yea, of Zion{H6726} it shall be said,{H559} This one and that one{H376} was born{H3205} in her; And the Most High{H5945} himself will establish{H3559} her.
Jehovah{H3068} will count,{H5608} when he writeth up{H3789} the peoples,{H5971} This one was born{H3205} there. {H5542}
They that sing{H7891} as well as they that dance{H2490} [shall say], All my fountains{H4599} are in thee.
